news.title: Satani Bearings Limited Announces Executive Changes, Effective from 02 April, 2026
news.body:
Satani Bearings Limited approved the appointment of Ms. Niyati Yogesh Lad [ACS: A62703] as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer (KMP) of the Company with effect from 02 April, 2026. Date of Birth 23 November, 1995. Nidhi Lad is an Associate Member of ICSI and has also cleared Bachelor of Law and M.com. Further She has completed her graduation in B.com. Niyati Lad is an Associate member of ICSI having experience in Company Secretarial work . The Company has accepted the resignation of Ms. Aakansha Vaid [DIN: 02796417] from the post of Independent Director of the Company w.e.f. 02nd April, 2026. Ms. Aakansha Vaid has confirmed that there are
no other material reasons for his resignation other than those mentioned in his resignation letter.

news.title: Paresh Gushabhai Satani completed the acquisition of 21.97% stake in Deccan Bearings Limited (BSE:505703) from Sumita Mishra and Sachin Shankar Shivgan.
news.body: Paresh Gushabhai Satani entered into share purchase agreement to acquire 21.97% stake in Deccan Bearings Limited (BSE:505703) from Sumita Mishra and Sachin Shankar Shivgan for INR 4.8 million on April 28, 2025. In a related transaction, Paresh Gushabhai Satani also entered into share purchase agreement to acquire 4.9% stake in Deccan Bearings Limited from Sachin Shankar Shivgan. A cash consideration of INR 4.8 million valued at INR 10 per share will be paid by the buyer. As part of consideration, INR 4.8 million is paid towards common equity of Deccan Bearings Limited. The Acquirers has agreed to purchase the Shares (“Sale Shares” / “SPA Shares”), and the Sellers have agreed to sell and transfer the Sale Shares in terms of the SPA.
